reference: No GNU or util-linux ramdisk exists, so every executed case is a contract: the documented bash-os interface (help text, synopsis, glibc getopt diagnostics with the coreutils Try line, dry-run output) checked in the candidate arm only.
coverage: Builtin registration, short and long help, --help and --version output.
Option and usage errors: wording, the Try line and status 1.
Validation before any filesystem change, and setup --dry-run reporting without creating anything.
The zram-unavailable path, with and without --root.
exclusions: Mounting, remounting and unmounting are not possible in the parity sandbox; tests/ramdisk-smoke.py covers them in a private namespace.
zram devices need the kernel module; the smoke test drives the sysfs sequence against a fake tree.

cases.purpose: The statically registered ramdisk command is a builtin; nothing is mounted.
Bash short help shows the catalog synopsis from config/bash-loadables.list.
Bash help carries the documented verbs, the standard set setup mounts and the exit status.
cases.script:
doc=$(help ramdisk)
if [[ $doc == *'/dev/shm   tmpfs nosuid,nodev, mode 1777'* && $doc == *'/run/lock  tmpfs nosuid,nodev,noexec, mode 1777, size 5m'* && $doc == *'/dev/mqueue  mqueue'* && $doc == *'only with --tmp'* && $doc == *'-f/--force'* && $doc == *'/sys/class/zram-control'* && $doc == *'Exit Status: 0 on success'* ]]; then
  printf 'documented ramdisk contract present\n'
else
  exit 1
fi

cases.purpose: --help prints the summary line and the usage synopsis of every verb on stdout, status 0.
cases.stdout:
Manage RAM-backed filesystems: tmpfs, ramfs, mqueue and zram.

    ramdisk [list] [-b|-h] [PATH...]
    ramdisk setup [-n|--dry-run] [--tmp] [--no-run] [--root DIR]
    ramdisk create [-s SIZE] [-m MODE] [-u UID] [-g GID] [-i INODES]
                   [-o OPTS] [-f|--force] PATH
    ramdisk resize PATH SIZE
    ramdisk remove [-l|--lazy] [--rmdir] PATH...
    ramdisk zram [--root DIR] add SIZE [-a ALGO] | remove N...

cases.purpose: Each verb's --help prints the same complete text as ramdisk --help.
cases.script:
ramdisk --help > all
for verb in list setup create resize remove zram; do
  ramdisk $verb --help > one
  cmp -s all one || { echo "$verb differs"; exit 1; }
done
echo same

cases.purpose: An unknown long option gets glibc getopt's wording and the coreutils Try line, status 1.
cases.script:
if ramdisk --x 2>err; then exit 90; else echo rc=$?; fi
msg=$(<err); printf '%s\n' "${msg#*ramdisk: }"
cases.stdout:
rc=1
unrecognized option '--x'
Try 'ramdisk --help' for more information.

cases.purpose: An unknown short option of a verb gets glibc getopt's wording and the Try line, status 1.
cases.script:
if ramdisk setup -q 2>err; then exit 90; else echo rc=$?; fi
msg=$(<err); printf '%s\n' "${msg#*ramdisk: }"
cases.stdout:
rc=1
invalid option -- 'q'
Try 'ramdisk --help' for more information.

cases.purpose: A long option missing its argument gets glibc getopt's wording and the Try line, status 1.
cases.script:
if ramdisk setup --root 2>err; then exit 90; else echo rc=$?; fi
msg=$(<err); printf '%s\n' "${msg#*ramdisk: }"
cases.stdout:
rc=1
option '--root' requires an argument
Try 'ramdisk --help' for more information.

cases.purpose: An unknown verb is a usage error with the Try line, status 1.
cases.script:
if ramdisk frob 2>err; then exit 90; else echo rc=$?; fi
msg=$(<err); printf '%s\n' "${msg#*ramdisk: }"
cases.stdout:
rc=1
unknown command 'frob'
Try 'ramdisk --help' for more information.

cases.purpose: create validates SIZE before touching the filesystem: status 1, no directory made, no mount attempted.
cases.script:
if ramdisk create -s 12x d 2>err; then exit 90; else echo rc=$?; fi
msg=$(<err); printf '%s\n' "${msg#*ramdisk: }"
[[ ! -e d ]] && echo 'no d'
cases.stdout:
rc=1
create: invalid size '12x'
no d

cases.purpose: setup -n --tmp --root r reports the standard set it would make and mount (the mqueue lines depend on the host kernel and are left out) and creates nothing.
cases.script:
mkdir r
ramdisk setup -n --tmp --root r > out
while IFS= read -r line; do [[ $line == *mqueue* ]] || printf '%s\n' "$line"; done < out
shopt -s nullglob dotglob
set -- r/*
echo "entries in r: $#"
cases.stdout:
would create r/run
would mount r/run (tmpfs, mode 755)
would create r/run/lock
would mount r/run/lock (tmpfs, mode 1777, size 5m)
would create r/dev/shm
would mount r/dev/shm (tmpfs, mode 1777)
would create r/tmp
would mount r/tmp (tmpfs, mode 1777)
entries in r: 0

cases.purpose: The sandbox has no sysfs, so there is no /sys/class/zram-control: zram add says zram is not available, status 1.
cases.script:
if ramdisk zram add 64m 2>err; then exit 90; else echo rc=$?; fi
msg=$(<err); printf '%s\n' "${msg#*ramdisk: }"
cases.stdout:
rc=1
zram not available in this kernel (no /sys/class/zram-control)

cases.purpose: With --root, the zram-control directory is looked for below that root; a fixture root without one gives the same refusal.
cases.script:
mkdir r
if ramdisk zram --root r remove 0 2>err; then exit 90; else echo rc=$?; fi
msg=$(<err); printf '%s\n' "${msg#*ramdisk: }"
cases.stdout:
rc=1
zram not available in this kernel (no r/sys/class/zram-control)

cases.purpose: setup, create, resize, remove and list against real tmpfs and mqueue mounts.
cases.reason: The parity sandbox forbids mounts. tests/ramdisk-smoke.py runs these in a private user, mount and IPC namespace (unshare -rmi) below a scratch root and checks the results with mountinfo, statvfs and stat.
